name: kill-write-pre-commit-only
body: The crash-durability test deterministically kills a writer while it queues on the blocking worktree lock (the pre-commit half), not inside node-file-write to commit to projection. A kill after the commit but before the projection can leave the derived database one projection behind the committed node file, so the test asserts only the pre-commit atomic guarantee. Upgrade when the write path exposes a deterministic pause or abort hook inside the write-through orchestrator.
